Defined in: core/tokens/starfield/params/bodies.ts:570

Nebula depth layering — a parallax echo + wide underlay glow composed under the photo sprite so a nebula reads as a volume of gas at different depths instead of one flat billboard. The *_RATE/_FREQ/_WAVE members drive the ambient-life pass in updateFx: each layer swirls (SpriteMaterial.rotation is a UV-space turn, so the feathered photo churns in place rather than orbiting) and breathes opacity on detuned sines; rates are seeded from the body id so no two nebulae churn alike.
